title: A Read node told the wrong colourspace for its file
symptom: The plate looks flat and slightly milky next to the reference. Everyone assumes it is the grade. Nothing errors.
errors: No. The file loads, the comp renders, the shot delivers.
check: Parse the Read node's file extension and its colorspace knob. A linear EXR read as sRGB, or a log DPX read as linear, is a mismatch that is decidable from the two values alone with no image needed.
skill: Know that a Read node's colorspace is a declaration about the file rather than a look, and that getting it wrong is invisible until it is composited against something correct.

title: A Merge with A and B the wrong way round
symptom: The element sits behind the plate instead of over it. In a dark shot nobody notices for two days.
errors: No. Merge accepts either order and renders happily.
check: Follow the graph: the input carrying the alpha-bearing element should be A and the background should be B for an over. Decidable from which upstream branch contains the element chain.
skill: Know which input is which on a Merge, and that over is not commutative.

title: A colour correction on premultiplied pixels with no unpremult around it
symptom: Edges go dark and crunchy over the background. The artist paints them out by hand rather than finding the cause.
check: Walk the chain: a Grade or ColorCorrect fed by premultiplied output with no Unpremult before and Premult after, and no (un)premult knob set on the node itself.
skill: Know that colour maths on associated alpha darkens every semi-transparent pixel, and that the fix is structural rather than a paint fix.

title: A ZDefocus reading a depth channel that was normalised to 0 and 1
symptom: The defocus looks flat and the focal plane will not sit where the artist puts it, whatever they type.
check: The depth input's range against the ZDefocus focal-plane and depth-of-field values. A 0-to-1 depth with a focal plane set in scene units cannot ever be right.
skill: Know that depth must be in scene units for any depth-driven node, and that a normalised pass silently breaks every one of them.

title: A Reformat sitting before the filter rather than after it
symptom: The result is soft, or aliases on high-contrast edges. Reads as a bad plate.
check: Node order along the chain: a Reformat that reduces resolution upstream of a Blur, Defocus or Transform is throwing away the samples the filter needed.
skill: Know that filtering after a downres is filtering data that no longer exists.

title: A Write set to 8 or 16 bit integer on a comp handoff
symptom: The next department finds banding in the gradients and no headroom in the highlights. The file opens fine.
errors: No. It writes and it validates.
check: The Write node's file_type and datatype knobs against what the task states the deliverable is. A comp handoff to grade or to another vendor is float.
skill: Know what a downstream department needs out of a handoff, and that a valid file is not the same as a correct one.

title: A node in the critical path that is disabled rather than deleted
symptom: The control does nothing. The artist drags its sliders for an hour before anybody checks whether it is live.
check: Any node with disable set to 1 that sits on the path between the plate and the Write. A disabled node still looks live in the graph.
skill: Know to delete a dead branch rather than switch it off, because a disabled node reads as a working control.

title: A script frame range that does not match the plate
symptom: The last few frames repeat, or the shot is one frame short at the head. Only spotted on review.
errors: No. It renders every frame it is asked for.
check: The root first_frame and last_frame against the Read node's frame range and its on-error and before/after knobs, which decide whether the shortfall holds or loops.
skill: Know that a Read will happily invent frames outside its range, and which knob decides what it invents.
